items.label: 【Material】
items.value: The plus size 3/4 sleeve tops for women are made of 60% Polyester, 35% Rayon, 5% Spandex.Super soft and light, breathable and not stuffy.It is suitable for long-term wearing in spring, summer and autumn, and is comfortable for long-term sitting and movement.

items.label: 【Pleated Chest Design】
items.value: The pleated design helps to accentuate the bust line and conceal tummy fat, making it suitable for all body types.The curved hem adds a stylish touch, long enough to cover the rear.You can leave the hem loose to cover your hips and tummy, or tuck it in to highlight your perfect figure.

items.label: 【Match】
items.value: The womens 3/4 sleeve summer tops looks nice with jeans, leggings or skort. Good value for a day to day top. The womens plus size tops can be simple but charming -- pair with necklace, coat, sandals or casual shoes will be a stunning look.

items.label: 【Occasion】
items.value: The plus size 3/4 sleeve pleated tops makes this women's top versatile for nearly any occasion, including work, office, beach vacations, travel, outings, dates, parties, and club events, making it a perfect choice year-round.

items.label: 【Tips】
items.value: Machine wash or hand wash, do not bleach. Kindly wash and iron it at a low temperature to remove the wrinkles. (XL/XXL/3XL/4XL/5XL for Choice)Please check the size chart carefully before ordering.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: casual, daily wear, home, outdoors, work
